en.name: Revises rules on menstrual and caregiving leave
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Fussa City Ordinance on Working Hours, Holidays, Leave, etc. for Fussa City Employees
en.summary: The city will amend the ordinance that sets out rules on menstrual leave, caregiving leave, and caregiving time for city employees. It will review provisions on menstrual leave and provisions on the periods covered by caregiving leave and caregiving time.
changes: Revises provisions on the periods covered by caregiving leave and caregiving time
